entries.title: C0023 status audit: critical bond percolation on Z^d, 3<=d<=10
entries.statement: Historical C0023 asks whether theta_d(p_c(d))=0 for independent nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, 3<=d<=10, with theta_d(p)=P_p(|C(0)|=infinity) and p_c(d)=inf{p:theta_d(p)>0}. Garban–Steif (2012, Chapter XI) calls intermediate-dimensional critical nonpercolation open in its historical context. Two OpenAI preprints dated 2026-09-24 now report a proof for bond/site percolation on Z^3 and a general theorem for bond percolation on infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graphs with p_c<1, which includes every assigned Z^d. As of 2026-10-10, record this as REPORTED SOLVED, INDEPENDENT FULL-PROOF AUDIT PENDING; the 2026-09-07 'currently open' tag is stale, and this audit does not certify the new proofs. The public ComparatorChallenges files contain deliberate `sorry` theorem bodies and alone are not proof receipts.
assumptions: C0023 refers to independent nearest-neighbor bond percolation on Z^d
New manuscripts have not received a complete independent mathematical review in this packet

source.revision: 2026-10-10; primary PDFs Garban–Steif 1102.5761 and OpenAI 2026-09-24, theorem statements directly checked

entries.title: Finite-range compatible-anchor criterion for a lower percolating parameter
entries.statement: Let d>=2 and M>=L>=1 be fixed integers in nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d. Embed coarse z=(z1,z2) in Z^d with center c_z=L(z1,z2,0,...,0). Put S_z=c_z+[-L,L]^d and D_z(r)=c_z+[-r,r]^d, intersected with Z^d. Fix one translation-covariant total order on offsets of every S_z. Let h_z be the first vertex in S_z with an open path inside D_z(M) to its vertex boundary, or undefined if there is none. Let G_z require h_z and its four coarse nearest-neighbor anchors h_w to exist and require open paths inside D_z(M+L) from h_z to each h_w. Set R=floor(2(M+L)/L). If p0>0 and P_p0(G_0^c)<800^{-(R+1)^2}, then theta_d(p1)>0 for some p1<p0. Therefore at p0=p_c(d) the strict displayed inequality is impossible.
entries.proof_text: Each G_z reads only the finitely many edges inside D_z(M+L). Supports of coarse index sets at infinity-norm distance greater than R are disjoint, giving strong R-dependence. Coloring sites modulo R+1 in each coordinate bounds the probability of m specified bad sites by q^{ceil(m/(R+1)^2)}. The outer boundary of any finite good component containing 0 yields a bad star-cycle; summing at most (2m+1)^2 8^m length-m cycles gives P(0 in an infinite good component)>=1-q-9t(1+t)/(1-t)^3, t=8q^{1/(R+1)^2}. The threshold q<800^{-(R+1)^2} makes this positive. Consistent anchors along an infinite good component connect into an infinite original open cluster. A uniform-variable coupling across the finite support yields |P_p(G_0)-P_p'(G_0)|<=N|p-p'|, so the strict margin persists at some p1<p0. Translation invariance converts positive probability of some infinite cluster into theta_d(p1)>0.
assumptions: The globally identical anchor rule and internal connection event of w420/ATTEMPT.md

entries.title: Unproved dependence-matched block estimate in an independent C0023 route
entries.statement: In an independent block route for nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, d=3,...,10, let G_0(L,M) be the finite event that the lex-first vertices in five seed boxes of radius L (at coarse center 0 and its four coarse neighbors at spacing L) reach their own box boundaries of radius M and that the central chosen vertex connects inside the radius-(M+L) box to all four neighboring chosen vertices. The still-unproved input is: theta_d(p_c)>0 would force some finite M>=L>=1 with P_pc(G_0(L,M)^c)<800^{-(floor(2(M+L)/L)+1)^2}. The unique-infinite-cluster assumption yields only lim_{L->infinity}lim_{M->infinity}P_pc(G_0(L,M)^c)=0. This iterated limit is insufficient because the dependence range grows with M/L; an explicit numerical family q_fake(L,M) has the same iterated limit and misses every threshold. This is a gap label for that independent route, not a statement that the 2026-09-24 reported proofs fail.
assumptions: The asserted critical bound itself is unproved

relations.rationale: The block-gap statement names the exact strict estimate that is the antecedent of the block criterion; it does not assert that the estimate holds.
Both entries explicitly concern C0023, but the unproved input is only for w420's independent route and does not determine the status of the newer manuscripts.
